selection_reasoning: This forms a coherent multi-hop building sequence. First, the player chops trees to gather wood resources (logs and planks). Then, the player mines a birch sign (which requires finding it in the scene — the sign could mark the future library location). Finally, the player uses the accumulated wood materials to build a library structure. The chain progresses from resource gathering → site preparation (removing the sign) → construction, which is a natural Minecraft workflow.

Chopping trees provides logs and planks essential as primary building materials for the library walls and shelves

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because chopping birch trees with the iron axe causes birch_log items to drop into the player's inventory. Checking for at least 3 birch_log confirms meaningful tree chopping has occurred (each tree has 4 logs, so 3 is achievable from a single tree). The player starts with 0 birch_log in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_sign block causes it to drop as a birch_sign item into the player's inventory. The scene has exactly one birch_sign placed at spawn-relative (0,0,7). The player starts with 0 birch_sign in inventory, so having 1 confirms it was mined.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='bookshelf' because a library in Minecraft is fundamentally defined by placed bookshelves. The chest provides 6 bookshelves; requiring at least 4 placed in a generous box around the designated build area (smooth stone platform from spawn-relative (-8,-1,2) to (-3,-1,7)) confirms a library structure was built. The box is expanded by ±3 in XZ and +5 in Y to allow creative placement flexibility. No bookshelves exist in the world initially — they are only inside the chest as items.

task_text: Chop the birch trees to gather wood, mine the birch sign marking the build site, then build a library on the marked smooth stone foundation using materials from the chest and gathered wood.
design_notes: Scene layout (relative to spawn at 0,0,0): TREES at (+3,0,+3), (+6,0,+2), (+5,0,+6) — three birch trees in a grove to the player's front-right. Each tree has 4 birch_log blocks (12 total) and a leaf canopy of 8 leaves each. CRAFTING TABLE at (+2,0,+3) and CHEST at (+2,0,+4) — right next to the first tree, easily discoverable from spawn. BIRCH SIGN at (0,0,+7) — straight ahead from spawn, readable text 'Library Build Site' with arrow pointing left toward build area. BUILD AREA: 6x6 smooth stone platform from (-8,-1,+2) to (-3,-1,+7) with cobblestone wall corner markers at all four corners. Player receives iron axe via /give. Task flow: chop trees (right side) → mine sign (center) → build library (left side on platform). All elements within 10 blocks of spawn for compact, discoverable gameplay.
